title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can explain it better in person sometime but they are kind of going down the road of managing the hockey and baseball business sides together. Long story short, it’s a very risky thing to do and it went very badly in Dallas already w the Rangers and Stars.
